data.exact_reserve_text: The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the host Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class. Corrective action has now been applied to this account to re-structure its composition and return it to the profitable performance it has historically produced. The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the host Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior year exposures. Recent development has been more stable, but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced adverse prior accident year development in 2015, particularly impacting certain Marine Insurance segments and the legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio. While the narrative explicitly states deterioration and strengthening of reserves, a specific monetary amount for this movement is not quantified in the financial notes or tables. The claims development triangle shows no movement for prior underwriting years, which contradicts the narrative.
